# sngl build emits a binary in cwd from a temp-dir generation.
# Requires a host Go toolchain (bubbletea inherits Builder from the Go lang).

[!exec:go] skip 'go toolchain required'

sngl build --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --opt name=myapp app.sngl
[toolchain] exists myapp

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component main node {
    text(value="hello")
}

window {
    main
}
-- testrun/build/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/1 --
sha256:7195ed8d825486eca40041e3e824bf4d
{}
